name: Yuuko
source:
“The only way to protect what you love is to fight—tooth and claw!”

Sometimes the essence of a person can be captured in a single word, and with Yuuko that word is ‘alpha’. Formidable and proud, she commands respect from all around her.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/GeniusBishoujo/status/1482699235187376130?s=20&t=bV6EA0oyHTTLY9Z7B6cGHw]official Twitter[/url]]
